A Digital-First Approach to Land Management The cornerstone of this reform is the complete digitalisation of the allotment process. This shift aims to eliminate discretionary practices and improve accountability in industrial development. Under the leadership of Samrat Chaudhary, the state is banking on these reforms to drive manufacturing expansion, attract private investment, and generate employment opportunities.
